description: The Flow rule engine (GIGA/Opta 4.4+): every rule as WHEN trigger / AND conditions / THEN actions in plain words with element names, its live state (enabled, running, last fired), the 32 global variables with live values and the webhook targets. id = one rule (with its raw JSON for editing); raw=true returns the whole flows.jsn (the format myio_flow_save takes). Editor/admin level.
